title: Adopt files one remediation task per failed standard and a row drains them
body:
Why: Fable 1115b slice 4; evals/standards-audit.md shows s-ci-runs-tests, s-linter-configured, s-readme-test-command red 3/3; brain reports but never closes the gap.
Outcome: krn adopt files one remediation task per failed record; a row drains them.
Proof: audit FAIL cells drop on >=2 rows, zero false-red; WordPress row measures s-skill-* records. ~$0.5.
